{{Engineer infobox}}

'''Mel Brandon''' is a ship [[Engineers|Engineer]] based at '''The Brig''' in the '''Luchtaine''' system of the Colonia region. A former Federal Defence Force specialist in laser weapons, shields, frame shift technology, and engines, he was dishonourably discharged after refusing an order to attack a labour protest.<ref name="edwiki-mel">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Mel_Brandon Mel Brandon], Elite Dangerous Wiki; in-game description and legacy Engineer record.</ref>

Brandon provides Grade 5 Engineering for eight module families and Grade 4 Engineering for [[Shield Cell Bank|Shield Cell Banks]].<ref name="inara-mel">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/22/ Mel Brandon — Engineer], INARA; current access, location, reputation, and service record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

The Brig is a surface Engineer base on Luchtaine A 1 c, approximately 1,466 Ls from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-brig">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/63947/ The Brig — Station], INARA; current facility and location record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Access requirements ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Stage
! Requirement
|-
| Discovery
| Receive a referral from [[Elvira Martuuk]] after reaching Grade 3 access plus at least one-third progress toward Grade 4.
|-
| Meeting
| Reach '''Friendly''' reputation with the Colonia Council and obtain its Engineer invitation.
|-
| Unlock
| Provide '''100,000 CR worth of bounty vouchers'''.
|}

The invitation is issued through the Colonia Council; it is separate from Brandon's final bounty-voucher hand-in.<ref name="inara-mel" /><ref name="frontier-forum-mel">[https://forums.frontier.co.uk/threads/guide-to-engineers-in-colonia.444749/ Guide to Engineers in Colonia], Frontier Forums; community-tested Friendly threshold and referral path.</ref>

{{Field note|INARA reports that station services may not appear immediately after the workshop is unlocked. Relogging should make them available.<ref name="inara-mel" />}}

== Reputation ==

Brandon's Engineer reputation is increased by crafting Engineering modifications at The Brig. Current records do not list a secondary reputation method.<ref name="inara-mel" />

He does not provide a direct referral to another Engineer.

Brandon is the only current ship Engineer who offers Grade 5 conventional Engineering for all three laser families, Frame Shift Drives, Frame Shift Drive Interdictors, Shield Boosters, Shield Generators, and Thrusters at one workshop.<ref name="inara-mel" />

== Operations-era services ==

The Operations update introduced ship modules and blueprints purchased with Merc Coins. Frontier describes these rewards as base modules that can be upgraded through existing Engineers.<ref name="frontier-operations">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-0-0 Elite Dangerous: Operations — Available Now], Frontier Developments; Operations rewards and Engineering model. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

Brandon currently offers five additional Live-only laser blueprints for compatible Merc modules:

! Blueprint

Overloaded and Regenerative are restricted to compatible Merc modules. INARA currently marks Regenerative's statistics as work in progress, but lists Brandon as providing it through Grade 5.<ref name="inara-overloaded">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/226/ Beam Laser — Overloaded], INARA; current compatibility and Engineer record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref><ref name="inara-regenerative">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/228/ Burst Laser — Regenerative], INARA; current compatibility and Engineer record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

Plasma Conversion is listed through Grade 5 for Beam, Burst, and Pulse Lasers.<ref name="inara-plasma-beam">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/203/ Beam Laser — Plasma Conversion], INARA.</ref><ref name="inara-plasma-burst">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/202/ Burst Laser — Plasma Conversion], INARA.</ref><ref name="inara-plasma-pulse">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/204/ Pulse Laser — Plasma Conversion], INARA. Records retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Referral position ==

Brandon is a direct Colonia referral from [[Elvira Martuuk]]:

<pre>
Elvira Martuuk
└── Mel Brandon [Colonia]
</pre>

[[Marco Qwent]] and [[Zacariah Nemo]] are parallel Bubble referrals from Martuuk rather than prerequisites for Brandon. Brandon is terminal in the current referral network.<ref name="inara-mel" />
